metadata.description: Marketplace of Claude Code plugins focused on Python code quality: PEP 20 (Zen of Python) as a practical guide for cleaner, more readable, and more maintainable code when you write, refactor, or review.

plugins.name: zen-of-python
plugins.description: Improves Python code quality using PEP 20 (Zen of Python): clearer structure, readability, and maintainability. Guides writing and reviewing any Python — programs, scripts, functions, one-liners — plus snippets, bug fixes, refactors, and code reviews. Triggers on Python work, PEP 20, style, or “is this good Python?”.
